steps.name: owner signs in through the real login form
Nova Website Designer opens for the project (initially saved, no pages)
editing marks the project as having unsaved changes
leaving with unsaved changes triggers the browser warning (beforeunload)
after reload the edited content is recovered from the database
database holds the page (owner JWT) with its version history
stale tab gets a version conflict and cannot overwrite newer changes
unsafe javascript: link is rejected and nothing is stored
no horizontal overflow at iPhone width in the Nova studio
non-owner cannot open the studio (redirected to login)
RLS: non-owner reads 0 pages and cannot modify them (own JWT, no admin key)

browser: Chromium (Playwright) with iPhone 13 profile — not Safari
